$description: Starter design tokens, W3C DTCG Format 2025.10. Golden-ratio scales (type step √φ, space and radius step φ), 60-30-10 palette (DES-14), all states (DES-36), elevation (DES-37), borders (DES-38), composite typography (DES-39). Three tiers: primitive → semantic → component; components reference semantic tokens (DES-02). Dark theme: tokens.dark.json overrides semantic tokens only (DES-40). Replace values with the brand's; keep the structure. Validate with scripts/check_tokens.py.

shadow.$description: Base color for shadow tokens; alpha set per shadow

iconStroke.$description: One stroke width for the icon set (DES-17)

scrim.$description: Image scrim for text over photos (LAY-17); not decorative (DES-21)

disabled-opacity.$description: Only for non-text decoration; disabled text uses color.text.disabled

eyebrow.$description: Label above a heading; not in the outline
